config.score.yaml:
# Score v1 parameters — every weight and threshold lives here, never in code (SPEC §5).
version: 1

weights:
  rarity: 0.35
  conservation: 0.25          # = -relative_attrition, normalized 0-1 (rank)
  sorn_ratio: 0.20            # UK only
  recent_inflection_point: 0.20

# Minimum sum of available weights to publish a score (missing components are
# excluded and the remaining weights renormalized to 1, never imputed as 0).
min_weight_coverage: 0.60

rarity:
  # Current stock tiers (SPEC §5): < 500 / < 100 / < 20 units, exposed as a label
  thresholds: [500, 100, 20]

attrition:
  smoothing_years: 3          # rolling mean window on annual attrition
  min_history_years: 3        # conservation / inflection unavailable below this many attrition points

peers:
  age_bucket_years: 5         # peers = same segment, same (age // bucket)
  min_peers: 3                # relative attrition unavailable with fewer peer observations

inflection:
  recent_years: 5             # inflection counts as "recent" if < N years ago
config.mapping.yaml:
# Make/model normalization parameters (SPEC §4).
# Share of the fleet (by count) of *target makes* that must resolve to a model_gen, per country.
min_coverage: 0.95
# Per-country override, for a country whose mapping is still being built: its coverage is
# still computed, logged and published in coverage.csv — only the gate is relaxed. Keep
# every entry dated, so a temporary exemption cannot quietly become permanent.
# 2026-09-13: DE was exempted while its mapping was written; it now passes the common gate
# at 96.6 %, so the exemption is gone. Re-add one only for a country being mapped, dated.
min_coverage_by_country: {}
# How many unmapped (country, make, model_raw) rows to list in the coverage report.
report_top_unmapped: 30
# model_raw values by which the source itself says the model is unknown: never mappable,
# counted apart and excluded from the coverage denominator.
unknown_labels:
  - "MODEL MISSING"      # DfT
  - "(MISSING)"          # RDW, and KBA rows with no trade name at all
  - "ONBEKEND"           # RDW
  - "SONSTIGE/NICHT GETYPT"  # KBA: "other / not typed"
  - "SONSTIGE HERSTELLER"    # KBA: "other manufacturers"
config.sources.yaml:
# Data source registry. URLs are verified by HTTP request and recorded in docs/SOURCES.md.
uk_dft:
  licence: OGL-3.0
  # Landing page listing the CSV assets; asset URLs change at every release and are
  # resolved at fetch time by scanning this page for the file names below.
  page_url: https://www.gov.uk/government/statistical-data-sets/vehicle-licensing-statistics-data-files
  files:
    - df_VEH0120_GB.csv
    - df_VEH0124_AM.csv
    - df_VEH0124_NZ.csv
    - df_VEH0160_GB.csv

nl_rdw:
  licence: CC0-1.0
  dataset_id: m9d7-ebf2
  api_url: https://opendata.rdw.nl/resource/m9d7-ebf2.json

de_kba:
  licence: DL-DE/BY-2-0
  # FZ 2 "Bestand an Kraftfahrzeugen und Kraftfahrzeuganhängern nach Herstellern und
  # Handelsnamen". Sheet FZ 2.2 is the model-level table (Handelsname); FZ 17 is make-level
  # only, and the FZ 10 named in early drafts of the spec does not exist.
  base_url: https://www.kba.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/DE/Statistik/Fahrzeuge/FZ2
  # The file name changed between vintages; both are tried, most recent convention first.
  file_patterns:
    - "fz2_{year}.xlsx?__blob=publicationFile"
    - "fz2_{year}_xlsx.xlsx?__blob=publicationFile"
  sheet: FZ 2.2
  first_year: 2019
  last_year: 2026
